text:
natalie_cs: Heads-up — Symmetry Health renewal stalled. Customer signed commercial but procurement refused to attach PO until we provide SOC2 attestation and confirm data residency on invoice. Quote: https://docsend.com/s/symmetry-renewal.

omar_ae: they want invoice split across two entities (UK + US) and a line showing data residency EU. Is that doable?

susan_fin: splitting invoice is possible but needs legal entity mapping and separate vendor codes. We also need SOC2 cert copy to satisfy their procurement policy.

compliance_bot: Auto-check: SOC2 status for Symmetry is not in shared vault. Recommend uploading the latest SOC2 report to secure link and redacting sensitive content.

ethan_legal: legal note: if invoice split across entities, we need a payment schedule clause and which entity bears tax liability. I'll draft a short clause: "Invoices will be issued to the entities listed on the attached PO; tax liability follows the invoiced entity."

mina_se: i'll prepare two SOW attachments: one for Symmetry UK Ltd (seats 40) and one for Symmetry Inc (seats 20). will also add Ethan's clause. who is the procurement contact?

natalie_cs: procurement contact is claire.procure@symmetryhealth.co and legal contact is ben. CFO is rosie@symmetryhealth.co. They want SOC2 + a signed SOW showing split before attaching POs for each entity.

compliance_bot: Note: recommended redaction flow: upload SOC2 to secure link with access token, then attach to DocuSign envelope. Use `vault.redact.soc2()` flow.

susan_fin: i can provision temp vendor codes: FIN-TEMP-UK-335 and FIN-TEMP-US-840 so they can attach POs and we can process invoice routing. Permanent vendor creation will follow once reg docs provided.

mina_se: drafting SOWs now. i'll include clause: "Invoices will be issued to the entities listed on the attached PO; tax liability follows the invoiced entity." exact phrasing per Ethan. Also mark billing schedules and proration for seat changes.

ethan_legal: approved. Also add: "Data residency: EU-hosted model execution and storage enforced for Symmetry UK Ltd data." paste that exact sentence.

omar_ae: can we also include a short note for operations: "Ops to confirm region pinning and provide staging proof within 48 hours of signature."

mina_se: added. creating DocuSign envelope with two SOW attachments and SOC2 link. DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/symm-2026-soc2 routed to Rosie then Claire. envelope expires in 7 days.

natalie_cs: pinging customer to say temp vendor codes available and ask for signed POs. also asked them to confirm which entity will bear initial invoice.

compliance_bot: Envelope note: ensure SOC2 link includes expiration and access token. Recommended token TTL 72 hours.

susan_fin: temp vendor codes FIN-TEMP-UK-335 & FIN-TEMP-US-840 issued. Finance will accept PO attachment referencing temp codes for processing. Reminder: permanent vendors require reg docs.

mina_se: Rosie opened envelope at 1829009400 and left a comment asking whether the EU data residency sentence applies to historical data as well.

ethan_legal: response: "Data residency clause applies to data generated after effective date; historical data retention subject to existing agreements." use that exact phrasing.

mina_se: updated envelope comments. also included a short ops checklist for region pin: `region: eu-west-1; model-pin: eu; kv-cache: segregated`

omar_ae: customer uploaded PO for UK entity at 1829010200 referencing FIN-TEMP-UK-335. US PO pending.

susan_fin: got the UK PO, queuing provisional invoice. once US PO arrives we'll split invoice and route accordingly.

natalie_cs: Rosie signed the envelope at 1829010800; Claire countersigned at 1829011160 and uploaded the UK PO. US procurement said they'll sign tomorrow morning.

compliance_bot: Reminder: SOC2 link TTL set to 72 hours; customer downloaded at 1829010900.

susan_fin: permanent vendor creation in progress for UK entity ENT-SYM-701. US vendor pending. Will update when both live and invoices processed.

natalie_cs: status: SOC2 provided, SOWs signed for UK entity, UK PO attached, temp vendor codes in use, waiting US PO. If US PO + permanent vendor come tomorrow we can close the renewal. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
